efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: Kara Newman
negative_reviews.text:
Order was delivered wrong so had to go back for the right meal to be made and delivered which left one person waiting whilst others ate rapidly cooling food.
One side was forgotten so again had to wait for staff to check with kitchen and deliver.
Food flavour itself was good. Staff were friendly and helpful.
Service charge of 10% was automatically included. I don’t like this - please give us the choice rather than having to say take it off.
£125 for 4 people (4 drinks, 4 mains, 3 sides) incl service charge.

Male toilet out of service. Accessible toilet had urine everywhere.
